'''Taros Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in their military forces during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. Stationed in [[King's Pass]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces who stole Thul explosives to frame House Thul in an attack on [[House Baliss]].<ref name="Explosive" />
